ideas.title: The Impossible Number 6 Glitch
ideas.angle: Commands the viewer to lift their right foot, rotate it clockwise, and draw the number six in the air with their right hand, causing an uncontrollable motor cortex override. The inevitable failure forces immediate rewatches and an explosion of confirmation comments.

hook.en: You cannot pass this simple test.

ideas.reason: Interactive physical challenges hold the highest completion and replay rates on YouTube Shorts because viewers attempt the test while the video loops, easily hitting 115%+ APV and driving viral comment debates.
sources: Journal of Neurophysiology - Limb Movement Interference and Neural Coupling
Scientific American Mind - Motor Cortex Inhibition

ideas.title: The Subconscious Foot Direction Rule
ideas.angle: Reveals how observing someone's feet during a conversation exposes their real subconscious priority, regardless of how engaged their face appears. High-status survival insight that triggers viewers to instantly test it in daily conversations and share their observations.

hook.en: Look at where their feet point.

ideas.reason: Non-verbal decoding Shorts consistently achieve 80%+ VVSA because they offer immediate, covert social power that viewers can verify in real life the same day.
sources: Joe Navarro - What Every BODY Is Saying: An Ex-FBI Agent's Guide
Journal of Nonverbal Behavior - Lower Limb Posture and Interpersonal Attitude

ideas.title: The 37 Mind-Reading Glitch
ideas.angle: Walks the viewer through a rapid-fire cognitive restriction funnel choosing an odd two-digit number between one and fifty with different digits, predicting thirty-seven with shocking statistical accuracy. Features an ultimatum comment trigger to subscribe if accurate.

hook.en: Pick a number between one and fifty.

ideas.reason: Direct interactive mentalist funnels create intense curiosity loops and produce massive comment engagement from viewers who are shocked by the accurate prediction or eager to post their outlier answer.
sources: Amos Tversky and Daniel Kahneman - Availability and Representativeness Heuristics
Psychological Reports - Random Number Generation and Subjective Odd-Digit Bias
